# Knowledge-Core: Constraints

## `constraints.project`

Status: `verified`

Preserve service ownership and explicit dependency injection; prohibit global mutable configuration or clients, service locators, unowned goroutines, unbounded retries, panic or os.Exit outside process entrypoints, and internal error leakage. scripts/generated-files.txt is the sole generated-ownership manifest; never hand-edit listed files, kitex_gen, or services/collaboration/src/generated. IDL sources are under idl/http/v1 and idl/rpc/v1 and generation must use repository scripts. Resource creation, readiness, shutdown, and cleanup follow bounded, reverse-order lifecycle rules. Documentation must describe only implemented and verified behavior and be updated when public runtime, contracts, boundaries, lifecycle, startup, or APIs change.

Sources: `user-confirmed`
